Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. tasks.descriptionPlain: By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete. Route One Credit Application (US & CAN) & E-Contracting (US ONLY) Validation Step 1. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > Credit Application > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 2. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > E-Contract > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 3. Select Setup in the CREDIT APPLICATION RouteOne option from Step 1 above- and under General section enter RouteOne Dealership ID Step 4. Select User Setup and add a RouteOne user ID. This Top ID MUST BE AN ADMIN in RouteOne. Step 5a. Map all Tekion ID's to their R1 User ID's in the lower part of the 'User' section. You will need to manually type their R1 IDs in the right side column. This section might not be required for credit app only but will be for all other functions. Step 5b. The Dealership RouteOne User ADMIN should login to RouteOne, navigate to the User admin Tab for each user. Each user should have a section that says 'Tekion DMS'. In the field, it should say TEKION DMS- [followed by their Tekion DMS ID/Employee ID (1234)]. Step 5c. For eContracting usage, the User Admin will also need to enable "import signable documents" within R1. They may need assistance from R1 support for this function. [FYI - Tekion HAS made the request for all needed items at this point.] Step 6. Create a test Deal, under credit tab, select New Application, select RouteOne, verify all require fields are correctly filled in, and submit. Log into RouteOne, and confirm application is pending in dashboard Step 7. Test e-contracting by selecting Econtract Actions > submit to RouteOne. Validate in RouteOne Portal **IMPORTANT NOTE: If Dealership is setup with SITES on Tekion DMS/ARC, then ALL Sites that use R1 (not normally Main site) must be setup with the configuration and mapping as per the previous Go-Live task above. [Each integrated Site MUST have their own unique R1 ID.] Integration not working. Here is how you can troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live and Go-Live tasks were completed. tasks.descriptionPlain: By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Video Walkthrough: https://vimeo.com/792069825/8f4d685239 Integration not working. Here is how you can easily troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live tasks are complete. Step 2: Notify your assigned Implementation Specialist that the integration is not working. Service Champion - Service Manager/Director

By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Video Walkthrough: https://vimeo.com/792069825/8f4d685239 Integration not working. Here is how you can easily troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live tasks are complete. By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete. Route One Credit Application (US & CAN) & E-Contracting (US ONLY) Validation Step 1. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > Credit Application > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 2. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > E-Contract > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 3. Select Setup in the CREDIT APPLICATION RouteOne option from Step 1 above- and under General section enter RouteOne Dealership ID Step 4. Select User Setup and add a RouteOne user ID. This this Top ID MUST BE AN ADMIN in RouteOne. Step 5a. Map all Tekion ID's to their R1 User ID's in the lower part of the 'User' section. You will need to manually type their R1 IDs in the right side column. This section might not be required for credit app only but will be for all other functions. Step 5b. The Dealership RouteOne User ADMIN should login to RouteOne, navigate to the User admin Tab for each user. Each user should have a section that says 'Tekion DMS'. In the field, it should say TEKION DMS- [followed by their Tekion DMS ID/Employee ID (1234)]. Step 5c. For eContracting usage, the User Admin will also need to enable "import signable documents" within R1. They may need assistance from R1 support for this function. [FYI - Tekion HAS made the request for all needed items at this point.] Step 6. Create a test Deal, under credit tab, select New Application, select RouteOne, verify all require fields are correctly filled in, and submit. Log into RouteOne, and confirm application is pending in dashboard Step 7. Test e-contracting by selecting Econtract Actions > submit to RouteOne. Validate in RouteOne Portal **IMPORTANT NOTE: If Dealership is setup with SITES on Tekion DMS/ARC, then ALL Sites that use R1 (not normally Main site) must be setup with the configuration and mapping as per the previous Go-Live task above. [Each integrated Site MUST have their own unique R1 ID.] Integration not working. Here is how you can troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live and Go-Live tasks were completed. Step 2: Notify your assigned Implementation Specialist that the integration is not working. F&I Champion - F&I Manager/Director

By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Video Walkthrough: https://vimeo.com/792069825/8f4d685239 Integration not working. Here is how you can easily troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live tasks are complete. Step 2: Notify your assigned Implementation Specialist that the integration is not working. Service Champion - Service Manager/Director

By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Video Walkthrough: https://vimeo.com/792069825/8f4d685239 Integration not working. Here is how you can easily troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live tasks are complete. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. partsTasks.taskName: Submit Dealership Infrastructure Conversion Support Ticket
partsTasks.descriptionPlain: For any dealers identified for Centralized Name File (CNF), Centralized Accounting, Enterprise or Multi-Site configurations, raise a support ticket with needed structural and conversion requirements. Centralized Name File (CNF): This is a single name file shared across multiple dealerships/ rooftops/ Dealer IDs where all locations use the same customer and vendor database. Limit of one Centralized Name File per Tenant. If the current organization is not on a Central Name File/ Single Name File, the conversion team will need to be provided prefix or suffix logic by Dealer ID to be merged. (The recommendation is to provide suffixing logic as it simplifies the end-user experience when searching for Charge Customers or Vendors.) Tekion is unable to assist with customer or vendor merge as part of the Conversion. Centralized Accounting: If a group is implementing Centralized Accounting, the above logic for Centralized Name File must be provided to the conversion team. Centralized Name File is a requirement for Centralized Accounting. The Conversion team also needs to be notified to ensure the Centralized Accounting feature is enabled and APIs are run. Multi-Site (Sites): For this consolidated structure the Multi-Site approval process must be completed with unique Sites structural requirements identified (ie: shared/ separate parts inventory, shared/ separate used car inventory, etc.) Once verified, the conversion team must be provided with the details for how the data should be split by Site ID (included in the approval spreadsheet) and shared via a conversion support ticket. Enterprise: This is the customer's ability to have a single data base for employees and user management with additional features supporting enterprise level reporting and some other cross company features. The Enterprise blueprint must be completed as part of the enablement. For additional details around any of these features, please work with the Account Executive (AE) and Sales Engagement Manager (SEM) to coordinate demos and any contractual change requirements. Please note: Any late identification of these structural requirements will likely result in a launch date change and may incur additional fees.

Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. partsTasks.taskName: Submit Dealership Infrastructure Conversion Support Ticket
partsTasks.descriptionPlain: For any dealers identified for Centralized Name File (CNF), Centralized Accounting, Enterprise or Multi-Site configurations, raise a support ticket with needed structural and conversion requirements. Centralized Name File (CNF): This is a single name file shared across multiple dealerships/ rooftops/ Dealer IDs where all locations use the same customer and vendor database. Limit of one Centralized Name File per Tenant. If the current organization is not on a Central Name File/ Single Name File, the conversion team will need to be provided prefix or suffix logic by Dealer ID to be merged. (The recommendation is to provide suffixing logic as it simplifies the end-user experience when searching for Charge Customers or Vendors.) Tekion is unable to assist with customer or vendor merge as part of the Conversion. Centralized Accounting: If a group is implementing Centralized Accounting, the above logic for Centralized Name File must be provided to the conversion team. Centralized Name File is a requirement for Centralized Accounting. The Conversion team also needs to be notified to ensure the Centralized Accounting feature is enabled and APIs are run. Multi-Site (Sites): For this consolidated structure the Multi-Site approval process must be completed with unique Sites structural requirements identified (ie: shared/ separate parts inventory, shared/ separate used car inventory, etc.) Once verified, the conversion team must be provided with the details for how the data should be split by Site ID (included in the approval spreadsheet) and shared via a conversion support ticket. Enterprise: This is the customer's ability to have a single data base for employees and user management with additional features supporting enterprise level reporting and some other cross company features. The Enterprise blueprint must be completed as part of the enablement. For additional details around any of these features, please work with the Account Executive (AE) and Sales Engagement Manager (SEM) to coordinate demos and any contractual change requirements. Please note: Any late identification of these structural requirements will likely result in a launch date change and may incur additional fees.

Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete. Route One Credit Application (US & CAN) & E-Contracting (US ONLY) Validation Step 1. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > Credit Application > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 2. Navigate to Sales Setup tile > Integrations tab > E-Contract > RouteOne -> Toggle to 'ON' Step 3. Select Setup in the CREDIT APPLICATION RouteOne option from Step 1 above- and under General section enter RouteOne Dealership ID Step 4. Select User Setup and add a RouteOne user ID. This Top ID MUST BE AN ADMIN in RouteOne. Step 5a. Map all Tekion ID's to their R1 User ID's in the lower part of the 'User' section. You will need to manually type their R1 IDs in the right side column. This section might not be required for credit app only but will be for all other functions. Step 5b. The Dealership RouteOne User ADMIN should login to RouteOne, navigate to the User admin Tab for each user. Each user should have a section that says 'Tekion DMS'. In the field, it should say TEKION DMS- [followed by their Tekion DMS ID/Employee ID (1234)]. Step 5c. For eContracting usage, the User Admin will also need to enable "import signable documents" within R1. They may need assistance from R1 support for this function. [FYI - Tekion HAS made the request for all needed items at this point.] Step 6. Create a test Deal, under credit tab, select New Application, select RouteOne, verify all require fields are correctly filled in, and submit. Log into RouteOne, and confirm application is pending in dashboard Step 7. Test e-contracting by selecting Econtract Actions > submit to RouteOne. Validate in RouteOne Portal **IMPORTANT NOTE: If Dealership is setup with SITES on Tekion DMS/ARC, then ALL Sites that use R1 (not normally Main site) must be setup with the configuration and mapping as per the previous Go-Live task above. [Each integrated Site MUST have their own unique R1 ID.] Integration not working. Here is how you can troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live and Go-Live tasks were completed. Step 2: Notify your assigned Implementation Specialist that the integration is not working. F&I Champion - F&I Manager/Director

By completing this task, you are confirming that all of the below validation activities are complete.   Due to additional validation activities performed by the vendor, we typically see this integration working no earlier than the afternoon of go-live date. Link for Sunbit Pay Over Time visible to the consumer in the service Appointment confirmation and reminders, as well as the consumer portal: The customer is required to fill in a 30-second application form with details like Name, Phone number, email id, address, etc.  When a customer is logged in to the customer portal and schedules an appointment, the customer automatically gets a confirmation with their repair order, service cost, and a monthly payment example with the option to pre-qualify for the payment plan via Sunbit. The customer can click on the Prequalify Now button on the order summary page. This helps the customers to plan and budget beforehand giving them the option to service now and pay over time.  A Pre-Qualified Total amount is visible on the check-in page once the customer is pre-approved by Sunbit. When it is time to pay, customers already know how much money they can access and complete their purchase using the Sunbit payment plan that fits their needs. Customers can use their own devices to select Pay Overtime with Sunbit on the customer portal and can choose a payment plan, and complete the purchase. Video Walkthrough: https://vimeo.com/792069825/8f4d685239 Integration not working. Here is how you can easily troubleshoot: Step 1: Validate Pre Go-Live tasks are complete. Step 2: Notify your assigned Implementation Specialist that the integration is not working. Service Champion - Service Manager/Director
